trigger.description: The optional user-global memory lane was skipped because its store was written by a different schema version and needs a migration. Workspace results are fully scope-verified and unaffected, so this is info severity on the read path. Previously this surfaced as scope_metadata_unavailable at medium severity, which made every search in such a workspace look like its own scope verification had failed. The repair addresses the global store database directly because `ee migrate run` has no --global switch.
setup_commands: # leave the user-global store at an older schema than the running binary
